title: Global dashboard reads rollups only with staleness display
description: WHY: the dashboard is the first consumer that proves the contract - and today any global view that opens project state directly is coupled to every project schema version at once. WHAT: rework the bwrk global dashboard payload (apps/cli global command handling and the console global-dashboard component) to source exclusively from the aggregate read API: per-project cards showing counts, limbo, blocking gaps, doctor state, and a generatedAt-based staleness badge; lifecycle states render distinctly (paused and archived projects visible but dimmed or hidden per view option, missing flagged). Remove or fence any direct cross-project state.json reads behind the aggregator. Both the CLI dashboard view and the console web view consume the same JSON payload - keep the console contract-driven per docs/architecture/CONSOLE_APP.md.
acceptanceCriteria: Global dashboard renders entirely from rollup cache data with per-project staleness badges
A project with a deleted directory renders as missing without breaking the dashboard, covered by a test
